scope: One prespecified saved-feature learner comparison; development evidence only, not fresh blind validation. No new labels, searches, features, app changes, or deployment.
reference: Exact custom 64-tree depth6/leaf8 distinct moves/mtry12/group bootstrap/cost5 split/raw leaf trainer, retrained on each fold. Fixed threshold5/6. Never evaluate deployed848 model on expanded training it has seen.
fairness: Same75features+75missing flags, eligible window rows, equal total initial move weight, 2window minimum score, confidence/physical gates. Standard RF bootstraps window rows rather than whole groups; validation remains grouped.16unique training rows per RF leaf implies >=8moves, but is not identical to custom group-bootstrap distinct-move constraint. Standard learners use native missing routing and unweighted classes; thresholds handle award selectivity. Learner package comparison, not bitwise algorithm ablation.
splits: Reuse deterministic 5outer/3inner whole-game+canonical-before groups and seeds from original optimization. Both windows and aliases stay grouped.
threshold_selection: On inner OOF only, maximizeTP subject to FP(all negatives, including easy)<=fixed-referenceFP AND false-discovery fraction<=fixed reference. Ties fewerFP then higher cutoff. Thresholds are unique observed min-window scores, ties kept together. Empty awards allowed if no feasible nonempty point.
primary_procedure: Choose max innerTP then fewerFP from4arms, tie order fixed custom,retuned custom,standardRF,histboost. Fixed reference fallback. Outer fold labels never select learner/cutoff. Report all arm outcomes and selected-procedure result including failures.
final_selection: Separate5fold calibration on all training, same final salts/seeds as prior optimization; choose with same rule, fit one chosen model and freeze before already-seen654 replay. No candidate revisions after results.
checks: Input/kernel/script hashes; game/alias/position group integrity; original reference outer TP/FP parity and saved final OOF score parity<1e-12; no train-test group overlap; finite predictions; replay excludes training games.
uncertainty: 2000 paired group bootstrap draws conditional on fixed OOF predictions. Report recall and FP count difference intervals; no claim they include model fitting or accumulated research selection uncertainty.
